_comment: kaizen :: the hooks that are ACTUALLY active. Three, deliberately. Each one earns its place: PreToolUse is a safety net whose patterns can never match legitimate work, SessionStart replaces tool calls Claude would otherwise spend rediscovering repo state, and Stop nudges once per session and only when there is real work to flag. Everything else was a no-op stub and has been deleted rather than shipped as if it were a feature. See docs/decisions/0009-three-hooks-on-by-default.md.
_escape_hatches: KAIZEN_SAFETY=off disables the PreToolUse block. KAIZEN_NUDGE=off disables the Stop suggestion.
